simple.summary: קַרְתָּה (Qartâh) means Kartah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 21 34.

definitions.full: H7177. Qartah קַרְתָּה proper name, of a location Καδης , Καριθα , etc.: Levitical city in Zebulun Josh 21:34 , site unknown. קַרְתָּן see קִרְיָתַיִם 2 above
